formula.split_end_to_end_ms: measured prefill_ms on prefill device + measured decode_ms on decode device
formula.split_energy_net_psys_j: measured prefill PSys energy on prefill device + measured decode PSys energy on decode device

timing_semantics.ttft_ms: timed warmed prefill inference call that returns first-token logits
timing_semantics.end_to_end_ms: timed prefill plus first-decode and steady-decode inference calls
timing_semantics.energy_net_psys_j: idle-subtracted PSys energy during timed inference calls
timing_semantics.compile_s: recorded by source runs but intentionally excluded; cache state can change it
